# Skimbyte

> Skimbyte is a free, open-source app that turns developer-news feeds (Kotlin, Android, AI, tooling release feeds) into a once-a-day brief of short, readable summaries. It is built as a single Kotlin Multiplatform + Compose Multiplatform codebase shipping natively to Android, iOS, Desktop (JVM), and Web (Kotlin/Wasm + Kotlin/JS), and doubles as a production-shaped reference project: real architecture, a three-layer test suite (unit / Compose UI / Roborazzi screenshots), adaptive foldable-ready layouts, Navigation 3, Koin DI, and a living design-system catalog.

Skimbyte is developed by Redigit Softwares and has no ads and no tracking. A fresh clone runs in demo mode on bundled sample data, so every platform target works end to end without a backend.

## Docs

- [Documentation home](https://skimbyte.com/docs/): overview, platforms, and quick start
- [Architecture](https://skimbyte.com/docs/architecture/): modules, state management, navigation, and DI
- [Testing](https://skimbyte.com/docs/testing/): the unit / Compose UI / screenshot test layers
- [Design system](https://skimbyte.com/docs/design-system/): tokens, components, and the designsheet catalog
- [API reference](https://skimbyte.com/docs/api/): Dokka-generated API docs for the shared module
- [Live designsheet](https://skimbyte.com/docs/designsheet/): the component catalog running in the browser (Wasm)
- [Download](https://skimbyte.com/docs/download/): desktop installers for macOS, Windows, and Linux
